description: Tool to expire an active Stripe Checkout Session. Use when you need to prevent customers from completing an open checkout session.

session_id.description: The ID of the checkout session to expire. Must be an active session with 'open' status.
session_id.title: Session Id

name: expire_checkout_session

city.description: City, district, suburb, town, or village.
city.title: City

line1.description: Address line 1 (e.g., street, PO Box, or company name).
line1.title: Line1

line2.description: Address line 2 (e.g., apartment, suite, unit, or building).
line2.title: Line2

enabled.description: Whether Stripe automatically computes tax on this session.
enabled.title: Enabled

status.description: The status of the most recent automated tax calculation for this session.
status.title: Status

amount_subtotal.description: Total of all items before discounts or taxes are applied.
amount_subtotal.title: Amount Subtotal

amount_total.description: Total of all items after discounts and taxes are applied.
amount_total.title: Amount Total

automatic_tax.description: Settings for automatic tax lookup for this session.
automatic_tax.title: Automatic Tax

cancel_url.description: The URL the customer will be directed to if they decide to cancel payment and return to your website.
cancel_url.title: Cancel Url

client_reference_id.description: A unique string to reference the Checkout Session.
client_reference_id.title: Client Reference Id

created.description: Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
created.title: Created

currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code, in lowercase.
currency.title: Currency

customer.description: The ID of the customer for this session.
customer.title: Customer

customer_details.description: The customer details including the customer's tax exempt status and the customer's tax IDs.
customer_details.title: Customer Details

customer_email.description: If provided, this value will be used when the customer object is created.
customer_email.title: Customer Email

expires_at.description: The timestamp at which the Checkout Session will expire.
expires_at.title: Expires At

id.description: Unique identifier for the Checkout Session object.
id.title: Id

invoice.description: The ID of the invoice created for this Checkout Session, if it is in subscription mode.
invoice.title: Invoice

livemode.description: Has the value true if the object exists in live mode or the value false if the object exists in test mode.
livemode.title: Livemode

locale.description: The IETF language tag of the locale Checkout is displayed in.
locale.title: Locale

metadata.description: Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to an object.
metadata.title: Metadata

mode.description: The mode of the Checkout Session. One of 'payment', 'setup', or 'subscription'.
mode.title: Mode

object.description: String representing the object's type. Always 'checkout.session'.
object.title: Object

payment_intent.description: The ID of the PaymentIntent for Checkout Sessions in payment mode.
payment_intent.title: Payment Intent

payment_method_types.description: A list of the types of payment methods (e.g., 'card') this Checkout Session can accept.
payment_method_types.title: Payment Method Types

payment_status.description: The payment status of the Checkout Session. One of 'paid', 'unpaid', or 'no_payment_required'.
payment_status.title: Payment Status

setup_intent.description: The ID of the SetupIntent for Checkout Sessions in setup mode.
setup_intent.title: Setup Intent

status.description: The status of the Checkout Session. Will be 'expired' after successful expiration.
status.title: Status

subscription.description: The ID of the subscription for Checkout Sessions in subscription mode.
subscription.title: Subscription

success_url.description: The URL the customer will be directed to after the payment or subscription creation is successful.
success_url.title: Success Url

total_details.description: Tax and discount details for the computed total amount.
total_details.title: Total Details

ui_mode.description: The UI mode of the Session. One of 'hosted', 'embedded', or 'custom'.
ui_mode.title: Ui Mode

url.description: The URL to the Checkout Session.
url.title: Url

type.description: The type of the tax ID (e.g., 'eu_vat', 'us_ein', 'br_cpf').
type.title: Type

value.description: The value of the tax ID.
value.title: Value

amount_discount.description: Total discount amount applied to the session.
amount_discount.title: Amount Discount
